The worst experience ever. Contacted them the day I recieved my order with the broken bottle. Only once did someone try coming to pick up the bottle where I couldnt go down because of my baby and after that no more attempts. They had told me to check online what time they were going to come pick it up but it only showed that they were out 2 hours before i got a call that they were downstairs, what if i wasnt home? After numerous messages back and forth and almost 3 weeks later, i told them i'll just keep the product and put into another bottle but that they should reimburse me somehow for the trouble but i get a message days later thanking me for understanding.  I never write a negative review but this left a sour taste and i expected better from such a big brand.
